owner: UX integrated journey; Firstmate routes decisions

instructions.start: Try Mara's journey. Answer a step question when ready; the demo works without an answer.
neverAskAgain: whether requested application/LinkedIn/capture should be explored
instructions.capture: One persistent guided-decision tray follows the current journey step. No recommendation preselected; preview alternatives locally, then explicitly queue one advisory answer with D-ID/question-ID. Firstmate records exact words; this never releases the global implementation gate.
instructions.progressive: Show only relevant first-round card at its step. Remaining seven under More decisions, not a wall.

questions.question: Which candidate group should validate the first journey?
questions.userProblem: A realistic main story needs an initial validation group; experienced users, juniors and career changers bring different missing-evidence problems.

options.label: Experienced RO/EN applicants with a target job
options.consequence: Start validation with the existing Mara story and genuine role/achievement evidence; keep junior and career-change edge cases.

options.label: Juniors and career changers first
options.consequence: Prioritize projects, education and transferable evidence; more of the main story must be adapted and checked.

options.label: A mixed general audience from the start
options.consequence: Broader initial usability and matching corpus; more scenario variation and review effort before concluding the journey works.

questions.rationale: A provisional validation slice reuses the coherent synthetic story already under design. It is not evidence of demand or a decision to exclude other users.
questions.scopeImplication: Job-specific promise and Base-only route stay directed. Change which examples and acceptance cases receive first attention; retain junior/career-change recovery and honest missing-evidence states.
questions.costImplication: No numeric demand or cost delta established. More candidate/occupation scenarios increase evaluation and support scope; this is not a selling-price decision.
questions.alreadyDirected: Job-specific CV outcome and immediate Base guidance are directed; do not reopen that product focus as a choice.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: How much improvement must happen before the user can continue?
questions.userProblem: An interview can feel like a barrier before value; unconfirmed facts must not become trusted evidence.

options.label: Review first; questions progressively beside sections
options.consequence: Every section has guidance; answer/skip/save, then explicit fact confirmation.

options.label: Complete a required interview first
options.consequence: More upfront coverage, longer path before first useful draft.

options.label: Only ask on demand
options.consequence: Less interruption, but advice may be missed.

questions.rationale: Give the immediate diagnostic requested by the owner, then one concrete improvement at a time.
questions.scopeImplication: Prototype all section routes and skip/unknown; draft-save, confirmation and export gates remain distinct.
questions.costImplication: More interview turns can increase inference; the v2 onboarding scenario models 12 turns, not measured demand. Avoid full rewrites on every answer.
questions.alreadyDirected: Canonical structure, contribution/results helpers before rewriting, manual/AI skills with Append/Replace/Undo are already directed.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: What should the matching result emphasize first?
questions.userProblem: Several scores can obscure the next truthful change or encourage score chasing.

options.label: Action plan first, numbers and method expandable
options.consequence: Show important inclusion/question/eligibility action; keep both semantic results accessible and critical gap always visible.

options.label: Candidate Fit and CV Match comparison first
options.consequence: Two numbers immediately visible, with actions and distinct readiness/readability nearby.

options.label: Full assessment dashboard first
options.consequence: Maximum detail, more interpretation required.

questions.rationale: Preserve all directed meanings while helping the user act. This is an untested comprehension recommendation.
questions.scopeImplication: Five-category document readiness stays available; no job-dependent score without a job, no profile Candidate Fit when missing, no guessed readiness number.
questions.costImplication: Accepted mappings can be reused for CV projections per architecture; UI disclosure does not justify new AI calls. Readiness arithmetic is not yet supplied.
questions.alreadyDirected: ATS1.1 weights/strengths, two semantic scores, eligibility and actual PDF readability separation are directed; not asking to repeat them.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: When should an application workspace exist?
questions.userProblem: A user can finish a CV yet lose which version/contact/next step belongs to the job.

options.label: Create a lean record when a job is added
options.consequence: Job, latest CV/tailored status, search, sent count, stage, contact and next action; Continue on return. Submitted version remains in history.

options.label: Create only after the user chooses Track
options.consequence: Less automatic organization, extra action needed to retain continuity.

options.label: Full board/reminders/reporting at first release
options.consequence: Richer workflow, larger UX/privacy/notification scope.

questions.rationale: Preserves the owner's application-management aim without requiring contact administration before a CV is useful.
questions.scopeImplication: Lean workspace includes latest CV/tailored status, job/company/contact search, sent count, optional contact and next action; keep actual sent-version snapshot as separate history. Sent count derives from explicit user-marked submissions, not exports. No automatic messages/applications.
questions.costImplication: Plain records do not inherently require model calls; incremental storage/reminder/notification costs are not quantified in the relayed model.
questions.alreadyDirected: Application management with job-specific CVs, contacts and clear next steps is directed. Terminal strategy feedback additionally requires latest CV with explicit tailored/untailored label, a search bar and sent-application count; do not re-ask whether to add them.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: What job-capture boundary should the first release support?
questions.userProblem: Copying can be awkward; broad capture permissions and failed extraction can add friction.

options.label: Focused consented capture plus paste/manual recovery
options.consequence: User action → selected/visible job text → preview/edit → import; bounded site expectations.

options.label: Broad multi-site URL/extension automation
options.consequence: More convenience when it works; more fetching/security/site-maintenance scope.

options.label: Phase capture after a stated pilot milestone
options.consequence: Prototype the requested branch now; launch timing/depth explicitly deferred, never silently excluded.

questions.rationale: Keeps the requested capture capability in a bounded candidate; UX/architecture must validate authentication/permissions and recovery.
questions.scopeImplication: Capture only requested job content; no history/cookies/background scraping or bypass. Stage option needs explicit owner disposition.
questions.costImplication: Extension maintenance/fetching and job-extraction changes are not isolated as a measured cost in v2. Do not infer them from token rates.
questions.alreadyDirected: Owner requested job-capture extension; permission/launch depth is still unresolved.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: How should LinkedIn review receive the user's information initially?
questions.userProblem: A mandatory external-account integration can interrupt finishing the job CV.

options.label: Paste/manual or user-supplied own-profile document
options.consequence: Review clarity/evidence/keywords; show suggested edits and explicit optional Base promotion.

options.label: Consented profile capture/import through extension
options.consequence: Less copying; added permissions/auth/site-policy and correction work.

questions.rationale: Provides the requested review with an understandable return to the same application and no automatic external change.
questions.scopeImplication: Optional side branch, privacy scope visible, retain source and user confirmation; returning user sees the same job/CV record.
questions.costImplication: A separate review can add inference; no per-LinkedIn operation cost/usage was supplied. Reuse confirmed facts and meter requests, pending architecture.
questions.alreadyDirected: LinkedIn review requested; no automatic profile edit or authenticated scraping approved.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: Where can a future access/usage prompt appear after useful work?
questions.userProblem: A gate before value can obscure the product; unbounded AI can exceed an unapproved budget.

options.label: After Base advice and one job-CV comparison/preview
options.consequence: Value visible first; disclose approved limits before an export/additional operation.

options.label: After Base advice, before job matching
options.consequence: Less initial inference exposure; job-specific value appears behind access choice.

options.label: Before meaningful review
options.consequence: Less free workload, highest risk of unclear value.

questions.rationale: Matches UX's recommendation to demonstrate the job-specific result before commercial friction; this is not a selected free entitlement or price.
questions.scopeImplication: Meter operations, show clear limits/retry behavior; no real checkout in discovery and no automatic paid upgrade.
questions.costImplication: OpenAI inference is paid; fully-free runtime unproven. Known managed subtotals are scenario estimates, not a price/complete business cost.
questions.alreadyDirected: 1/3/6-month concept and clear renewal/cancellation required; free-first infrastructure pilot is a direction, not free/unlimited AI.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: What should happen when an uploaded CV is an image or cannot be extracted?
questions.userProblem: Unsupported import can strand the user before the first advice.

options.label: Text PDF/DOCX plus manual/paste recovery
options.consequence: Bounded initial extraction; original retained according to approved policy; explain partial results.

options.label: Add OCR at first release
options.consequence: More input coverage, additional accuracy/correction/runtime work.

questions.rationale: Offer recovery immediately; OCR is a deliberate launch choice, not an assumed free fallback.
questions.scopeImplication: Show error/retry/manual path in prototype; no data loss or false parse success.
questions.costImplication: OCR costs/capacity are excluded or unknown in v2; Worker Free CPU already unproven.
questions.alreadyDirected: Upload/manual and correction required; accepted file/OCR depth open.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: Which output breadth is needed for the first useful release?
questions.userProblem: The user needs a readable document accepted for the application, not just an attractive tiny preview.

options.label: One polished single-column PDF with style presets
options.consequence: Smaller tested rendering surface; full-size preview/page breaks essential.

options.label: Two distinct tested PDF layouts
options.consequence: More visible choice, more extraction/visual regressions.

options.label: PDF plus editable DOCX export
options.consequence: Useful for employers/workflows requiring Word, separate fidelity/testing path.

questions.rationale: Prioritize a convincing, editable full-size outcome. High fidelity requires real content, page behavior and usable controls.
questions.scopeImplication: Employer-required formats still govern; preserve DOCX import separately. Additional output routes remain explicit choices.
questions.costImplication: Rendering retries/long PDFs can affect quota/cost; DOCX/test-surface delta is not measured in v2.
questions.alreadyDirected: Modern job-specific CV focus and logical/extractable output directed; no fixed template/export count approved.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: What can a user do with existing career data after cancellation?
questions.userProblem: Unclear access can make the reusable profile feel unsafe to invest in.

options.label: Manual editing and basic data/document access remain
options.consequence: AI/premium operations stop under disclosed policy; no repeated paid generation needed for plain edits.

options.label: Read-only records plus data export
options.consequence: Lower ongoing editing support surface; returning improvements require reactivation.

questions.rationale: Preserve continuity/trust; exact paid templates/variants and retention still need owner/commercial review.
questions.scopeImplication: Publish exact access/end dates and recovery path; do not infer a refund/retention rule from competitors.
questions.costImplication: No numeric savings provided; privacy portability/deletion and operating costs must be assessed separately.
questions.alreadyDirected: Cancellation differs from deletion; no price or detailed entitlement selected.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: How long should raw uploaded originals remain available after confirmation?
questions.userProblem: Keeping evidence helps correction, while large originals consume quota and retain personal data.

options.label: Short disclosed recovery window, then remove original
options.consequence: Profile/provenance/versioned facts retained under approved policy; original recovery window needs an explicit duration.

options.label: Opt-in longer original retention with a clear limit
options.consequence: More recovery flexibility; more storage, deletion and disclosure work.

questions.rationale: Minimize raw storage while letting users correct extraction; confirm duration and regional/provider terms before launch.
questions.scopeImplication: No real deletion action in discovery. Clearly show what is retained and who processes it.
questions.costImplication: At the v2 10MB/user assumption, 100 users fill 1GB free file quota. Longer-retention sensitivity exists; total service cost still unknown.
questions.alreadyDirected: Managed/free-first/initial provider preferred; strict residency, retention duration and professional privacy review unresolved.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: What happens if a second truthful positioning title is not yet known?
questions.userProblem: Forcing a title can invite invented experience; hiding the second field misses directed structure.

options.label: Keep both fields visible and let the user continue with a question
options.consequence: Unresolved title flagged; export completeness policy remains explicit.

options.label: Require a confirmed second positioning focus before export
options.consequence: Consistent complete display, extra completion burden; never invent it.

questions.rationale: Ask for truthful positioning without corrupting employment titles. This is an edge-policy question, not asking again whether there are two fields.
questions.scopeImplication: Never use January for unknown month or sum concurrent elapsed time twice. Exact duration comes from agreed fixture/method.
questions.costImplication: No material inference saving quantified; avoid automatic title generation on every save.
questions.alreadyDirected: Two title fields, month/year selectors and years/months duration already directed. Partial dates retain uncertainty/overlap rules.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: How should a real skill in Base but absent from this CV be presented?
questions.userProblem: A generic “missing” label can make a presentation gap look like a career deficit.

options.label: Action “Add from Base” plus evidence/equivalence badge
options.consequence: Show included/omitted/uncertain/unsupported distinctions and relation strength separately.

options.label: Grouped keyword table with literal status and details
options.consequence: More compact expert view, more interpretation needed.

questions.rationale: Start with a truthful action and source. Five baseline statuses must not be confused with four evidence strengths.
questions.scopeImplication: Exact credentials cannot be met by transfer; no absent-evidence claim that the person lacks a skill.
questions.costImplication: Both can reuse the same accepted evidence mapping; no extra model call implied.
questions.alreadyDirected: Five keyword statuses, graded evidence and user-confirmation distinction directed; display precedence unresolved.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage

questions.question: If a pilot AI/export action reaches a limit, what recovery policy is acceptable?
questions.userProblem: A stalled export can break the application task; a free-first preference is not proven capacity or approval to spend.

options.label: Bounded queue/pause with manual recovery
options.consequence: Preserve edits and show what can continue; no automatic paid upgrade. Prove runtime before promising capacity.

options.label: Explicit owner-approved paid tier within a spending cap
options.consequence: More headroom only after amount, region, operating tests and upgrade triggers are approved.

questions.rationale: Matches the free-first objective and no-upgrade-without-approval constraint; measurement and an explicit ceiling can later permit B.
questions.scopeImplication: Demo queued/failed/retry/manual paths; before a real pilot agree comprehension and ATS/PDF/provenance acceptance evidence. Technical pass counts alone did not resolve owner confusion.
questions.costImplication: Worker Free modeled 50ms exceeds 10ms allowance; burst rendering can exceed daily quotas. Relayed managed costs are incomplete scenarios, not permission or a selected cap.
questions.alreadyDirected: Free-first is a constrained pilot objective; OpenAI inference is paid, no automatic upgrade, no production activation.
questions.status: unresolved; recommendation is not owner choice
questions.gateCoverage: D-13/14 extension requested; Firstmate confirms authoritative coverage
